verdict.rationale: Nix is a documented developer tool with substantial docs (nix.dev, the Nix manual), so agent-oriented documentation is a fair axis for it. Direct probes, however, returned HTTP 404 for https://nix.dev/llms.txt and for a markdown docs variant, and nothing in the pack describes llms.txt, markdown docs or other agent-oriented docs. Having a documented official CLI is a separate capability and does not count toward this story.
